scope: Critical draft persistence hook in an isolated React/Chromium component harness
checks: earlier normal flight cannot replace a queued positive answer with its rapid correction
failed critical write is retained and retried before the latest correction with fresh credentials
the same positive snapshot already in flight is not written twice
a failed preceding normal save does not discard a queued critical snapshot
conflicts stay blocked and explicit record replacement ignores late acknowledgements
limitations: Controlled send promises simulate persistence acknowledgements and failures. The 1000 ms autosave debounce is deferred; explicit save calls exercise serialization. This suite does not exercise the real backend, actual urgent popup, automatic debounce timing, clinical evaluation, or published build.
